subject: Unexpected EU embed token surge — evidence and provisional hold
messages:
From: Lucia Gomez <lucia@vectorai.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-09-14T08:12:00+02:00
Subject: Unexpected spike in embed token counts — urgent review

Hi Evelyn —

We're seeing a very large spike on our Sept 1 usage that pushed us well past our committed tier. Our finance team flagged invoice INV-2027-093 and wants a line-by-line explanation before payment. The spike appears to be concentrated in embedding calls (long inputs, repeated calls).

Attached is a screenshot of our dashboard and a short CSV with a few request ids. Can you pull the raw usage and let us know whether this is a metering issue on Redwood's side or if we accidentally replayed jobs from staging? Also, for EU VAT purposes: we need confirmation whether the disputed amount is subject to reverse-charge.

This is time-sensitive — our accounts payable is holding payment pending reconciliation.

Thanks,
Lucia
Director of Data Engineering
VectorAI

Attachments: screenshot-spike.png (image/png), sample-requests.csv (text/csv)

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
To: Lucia Gomez <lucia@vectorai.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-09-14T09:05:00+02:00
Subject: Re: Unexpected spike in embed token counts — urgent review

Hi Lucia —

Thanks for the flag and the samples. I'm sorry for the disruption — we'll prioritize this. Initial notes:
- I've placed a provisional hold on INV-2027-093 in our billing system to prevent collection while we investigate. This is a temporary hold (finance notice sent).
- Could you send an account-level usage export for Sept 1 (if you have one) and confirm any changes to API keys or CI jobs around Aug 31–Sep 1?
- For VAT: please confirm your VAT ID and whether VectorAI is registered in Spain; we'll coordinate with Billing once we confirm the technical cause.

Ben — can you review whether we've seen any known ingest duplications for VectorAI this week? Marissa, kindly prepare a sampling export from our usage ledger and put a CSV in the Drive link below so I can share it with the customer.

I'll circle back with an initial root-cause and proposed credit by EOD.

Best,
Evelyn Hart
Senior Account Manager | Redwood Inference

Related HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/HS-3492

From: Lucia Gomez <lucia@vectorai.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-09-14T11:30:00+02:00
Subject: Re: Unexpected spike in embed token counts — urgent review

Evelyn —

Thanks for the quick response. I've attached the full usage export for Sept 1 and our VAT details below. We did run a backfill pipeline on Aug 31 but it targeted an internal staging dataset; it should have used a staging API key. I'm including the invoice number again: INV-2027-093.

VAT ID: ESB12345678
Registered entity: VectorAI SL, Spain

We attached the usage-export-20270901.csv and a minimal log slice (redwood-usage-log-20270901.jsonl). Please let us know if you see requests with our production API key in that timeframe. Finance needs an interim credit estimate so they can move forward with partial payment if necessary.

Kind regards,
Lucia

Attachments: usage-export-20270901.csv (text/csv), redwood-usage-log-20270901.jsonl (application/jsonl)

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>, Lucia Gomez <lucia@vectorai.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-09-14T14:02:00+02:00
Subject: Re: Unexpected spike in embed token counts — initial hypothesis

Lucia / Evelyn —

Quick technical note from SalesOps after an initial look: we've seen a pattern where customer backfills that accidentally use production API keys (instead of staging keys) replay long-context requests and generate large embedding counts. The symptoms you describe (concentrated to embed calls, long inputs) fit that pattern.

What I'll do:
- Ask Infra to provide a 1% sample of token-level meter logs for Sep 1 for VectorAI (should include request_id, api_key_id, model, input_tokens, output_tokens).
- Propose a provisional credit equal to the portion of traffic where api_key_id corresponds to staging-to-prod mismatch; we'll estimate conservatively until full audit.

Evelyn — if we confirm that it was a backfill using prod keys, we should: (1) apply a provisional credit, (2) add a note to the invoice that the credit is provisional pending full audit, (3) advise VectorAI on key separation best practices.

I'll pull the sample logs and post them to the shared Drive. Marissa, can you draft the invoice note?

Ben Carter
Director, Customer Success | Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Lucia Gomez <lucia@vectorai.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-09-15T09:18:00+02:00
Subject: Re: Unexpected spike in embed token counts — provisional adjustment and next steps

Hi Lucia —

Thanks for the rapid collaboration and for sending the logs. We pulled a 1% sample from our raw ingestion ledger and matched it to your submitted request ids. Findings (initial):
- There are ~14k request ids on Sept 1 where we see duplicated session identifiers and identical payload hashes. These align with the time-range of your backfill (Aug 31 23:50 – Sep 1 02:40 UTC).
- The duplicated requests appear to have used your production api_key_id (key-XYZ-prod). That matches Ben's hypothesis about a staging job using prod credentials.

Proposed interim actions:
1) Apply a provisional credit of 50% of the disputed line-item while we complete a full audit (expected 5 business days). This will be reflected as a credit note against INV-2027-093 and will include a comment: "Provisional credit pending audit: duplicate replay detected."
2) We will not send this invoice for collection in the meantime — finance has been notified.
3) We will provide the full 100% audit report (token-level sampling and a clear attribution) within 5 business days; if audit confirms full duplication, we will issue a full credit to your account.

I've placed the sample CSV and our 1% meter-sample in the shared drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcdExampleShareLink
Attachments included: usage-export-20270901.csv, redwood-usage-log-20270901.jsonl

Please reply to confirm you accept the provisional credit and we'll draft the credit note formally. Also, if you'd like, we can schedule a short call to walk through logs and preventive practices for key separation.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Billing Operations Manager | Redwood Inference

Attachment: usage-export-20270901.csv (text/csv)
